answer: New identities enter a garden where each account locks a stake that grows with every linked sibling: the first stakes 50 POA, the second 150, the fourth 600, doubling per cluster member, so a saffron field of 100 fake agents costs 5,000 POA locked for 30 epochs while an honest singleton pays only 50. Rewards drip like nectar only after 14 epochs of consistent work, so the attacker recovers at most 400 POA before the cluster is flagged. Edge case: a genuine household sharing one device looks like a cluster, so members may appeal with a 200 POA bond refunded on proof of distinct operators.
